issuer: Transport for NSW, through Service NSW
note: Transport for NSW's fees page (read 2026-10-30) gives an unrestricted (gold) licence at $234 for 5 years (1, 3 and 10 years also sold) and a photo card for someone with no NSW licence at $68 for 5 years ($122 for 10). A learner licence is had from 16 and, under 25, held at least 12 months before the P1 driving test; the P1 is held 12 months before the P2; the P2 at least 24 months before a full licence: a full licence is kept from 20, the sum of those periods from 16 (a reading). The photo card is for residents over 16, so it is kept from 16.

sources.title: NSW Government, Driver and rider licence fees
sources.said: Unrestricted licence (gold) 1 year: $74 3 years: $172 5 years: $234 ... No NSW driver licence 5 years: $68 10 years: $122

sources.title: NSW Government, Provisional P1 licence
sources.said: If you're under 25 – you must also have held your learner licence for at least 12 months ... After you've been on your red Ps for 12 months, you can apply for your green Ps

sources.title: NSW Government, Provisional P2 licence
sources.said: Once you've held your provisional P2 licence for at least 24 months, you can upgrade to a full driver licence .

sources.title: NSW Government, Photo cards
sources.said: proof of address for any resident over the age of 16.
